# PersonaMail interface details

All PNGs are unchanged copies of the native-resolution crops previously extracted
from the author's PersonaMail paper, DOI 10.1145/3742414.3794765, Figure 1,
printed page 162. Local source PDF: `483357681.pdf`.

- `purpose-native.png`: Figure 1A; `research_portfolio/v2/persona-hires/prompt-direct.png`.
- `context-native.png`: Figure 1B structured selection/free-text detail; `factor-choices-detail-native.png`.
- `editor-native.png`: Figure 1C original editor; `research_portfolio/v2/oct01-source-quality/personamail-editor-complete-988x808.png`.
- `save-native.png`: Figure 1D two anchor cards; `research_portfolio/v2/persona-hires/saved-context-direct.png`.
- `reuse-native.png`: Figure 1E original anchor library; `anchor-reuse-native.png`.

The full native system figure is 2058 × 1216 pixels. Its UI images are raster
images in the source PDF. No upscaling, sharpening, AI generation or fabricated UI
was used. The independent details and HTML explanations improve legibility without
claiming to recover information that is absent from the source.

The A–E order and accompanying explanation follow Figure 1 and sections 2.1–2.3;
the dinner-invitation example follows Appendix C. Eight formative participants,
three existing tools and the review of 97 papers are reported in the original text.
